A QUICK DRIVER’S BRIEFING

FIND YOUR LINE.

Race to the finish through every checkpoint. Build speed before the striped ramps, fly across the gaps, and steer through the air to line up your landing.

W / ↑ AccelerateS / ↓ Brake / hold to reverseW + A / W + D Drive and steer left / rightSHIFT Nitro boostSPACE Tighter turnR Checkpoint resetC Camera viewESC / P Pause

Missed the landing? Press R to return to your last checkpoint (+3 seconds). Hold W and A together to turn left, or W and D together to turn right. A/D steers the wheels; the car changes direction when moving. Release W to coast, or hold S to brake and reverse. Nitro recharges while you drive. On a phone, use the on-screen steering and pedals.

Let’s get you back on track.
